## AI-Generated Fix (python)

```python
from flask import Flask, make_response

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/')
def index():
    response = make_response('<h1>Welcome to the Web Application</h1>')
    response.headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none';"
    return response

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8882)
```

---

## Explanation

The web application was missing a Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header, which is crucial for preventing various types of attacks such as Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). The fix involves setting a CSP header in the HTTP response to restrict resources to only be loaded from the same origin, thereby enhancing the security of the application.
